doc:
T6: fact look-ups from existing data and code (no new runs), each with its source; recomputed from the source
files so that every value has a registry key. Facts g (how 186 was fixed) and h (Welch or Student) are statements
about code and planning documents and are kept as text with their file:line sources.
Output: data/derived/rev4_T6.json.

b.source: data/derived/rev2_A3.json (cells; inputs data/E4/e4_escape.jsonl alone and data/revision/B3/b3.jsonl)
b.seeds: E4: noise seed 11000 + 1000 k + 100 level + rep (k = E4 index, level 0-2); B3: 51000 + 1000 k + 100 level + rep (level 0-2 for beta 5, 6, 7), rep 0-19

c.score: stuck-alone margin with the C3 rest drive (g_max - drive, N)

d.handedness: one (e_perp = e rotated +90 deg, b > 0 only)
d.noise_seeds: none (deterministic arm); perturbation seeds 900-904 (1e-9 m) plus one unperturbed run

e.source: data/derived/E6_analysis.json lifetimes (experiments/E6/analyze.py:122-136 stalls, :170-202 barrier_picture, :365-368 max_abs_diff; CHECK_T :49)
e.statistic: max over t in {30, 60, 120, 300} s of |S_pred(t) - S_KM(t)|

sample.stall: interval >= 10 s between exits (the first, approach gap excluded); open at 600 s censored

prediction.form: S(t) = mean_i exp(-lambda_i t) / mean_i exp(-lambda_i 10 s), lambda_i = nu exp(-dU_i / kT_eff(sigma*, tau_b,i))

e.test: none: a descriptive maximum distance at four times; S_KM is the Kaplan-Meier estimate, no p-value or band

i.definition: min over the two pair members of |y_i - 5| - w/2, w/2 = 0.4 m, at the saved snapshot positions
i.sign: positive when the member's centre lies laterally beyond the door edge (|y - 5| > w/2, behind the jamb's flat face); negative would be a centre inside the opening

g.answer: planned before the runs: the TOST sample size n = z^2 2p(1-p)/delta^2 with z = 2.927 (alpha 0.05 each side, power 0.80), p = 0.575, delta = 0.15 gives 186 per arm
sources: pedestrian-abs-plan wave2/SIGNATURES.md:6 and :18 (S7, 186 per arm at +-0.15)
experiments/E6/e6.py:29 SEEDS range(242, 428), first commit a48a386 (2026-11-08) before any E6 run
g.not_a_stopping_rule: no launcher, log or commit shows a compute-window or stopping rule; seeds 242-427 are the first 186 after the E1 seeds 42-241

h.flow_ratio: Welch: delta-method interval of the log ratio of means with Welch-Satterthwaite df (experiments/fixan/fix_a7.py:103-118, ratio_means; used by D_croma_integrity.d4 :268)
h.means: Student t with n - 1 df (fix_a7.tci :85-92; E10/analyze.py tci :59-67) for flow, fluctuation, gaps
h.matched_ratio: Student t on the logs over human runs (fix_a7.matched_ratio :135)
